commands.name: terminal-loopback
passed_test_names: real OpenSSH loopback route verifies both servers and preserves Unicode execution through a jump
real OpenSSH loopback route rejects a changed target host key without trusting or registering the route
real OpenSSH forwarding through a verified jump route local allocates a listener, drains binary response after half-close, and cancels
real OpenSSH forwarding through a verified jump route remote allocates a listener, drains binary response after half-close, and cancels
real OpenSSH forwarding through a verified jump route SOCKS domain request and pipelined binary payload survive request half-close
real OpenSSH forwarding through a verified jump route disconnect closes active client sockets and both local and remote listeners
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture Ed25519 waits for host approval before direct signing
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture Ed25519 signs independently after each verified jump hop
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture RSA SHA-2 waits for host approval before direct signing
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture RSA SHA-2 signs independently after each verified jump hop
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture session output drains across a live OpenSSH rekey
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture rejecting a real host key never asks the agent to sign
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture a changed direct host key fails before any signature
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture a changed final key signs only for the independently trusted jump
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture a refused agent signature has no password or interactive fallback
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture disconnect revokes a pending local-agent signature on a live route
real OpenSSH with an in-memory local-agent protocol fixture cancelling host approval closes authority before a late approval
skipped_test_names: real OpenSSH loopback route real PTY receives size changes and preserves final output and exit status
actual disposable Unix ssh-agent authenticates and forwards to ssh-add

name: crisp_cloud
publish_to: none
environment:
  sdk: '>=3.13.0 <4.0.0'
  flutter: '>=3.47.0'
dependencies:
  xterm2: 5.4.0
  uuid: 4.5.1
  crisp_storage:
    path: /workspace/scratch/4156e4a05f09/CrispCloud/packages/crisp_storage
  dartssh2: ^4.1.0
  web_socket_channel: ^3.0.0
  file_picker: 10.3.10
  flutter_riverpod: 2.6.1
  flutter_secure_storage: 9.2.4
  http: 1.6.0
  image: 4.12.0
  intl: 0.20.3
  shared_preferences: 2.5.6
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_localizations:
    sdk: flutter
  quds_office_engine:
    path: /workspace/scratch/4156e4a05f09/zotero-toolchain/crisp-host-harness/packages/quds_office_engine
  quds_office_editor:
    path: /workspace/scratch/4156e4a05f09/zotero-toolchain/crisp-host-harness/packages/quds_office_editor
dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: 3.0.2
flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

dependency_overrides:
  dartssh2:
    path: packages/dartssh2
  pointycastle: ^4.0.0

native_tmux_binary_acceptance: Not run: no system tmux binary installed. Protocol/client/input/persistence are exercised in the unit cohort.
source_scope: The 29 selected core tests, 3 optional live tests, their transitive local Dart imports (including conditional imports), complete tracked dartssh2 vendor/provenance, production manifests and lock, storage hook, and smoke/vendor runners. Full app and Office qualification are separate.
